looks.description: Suited. The default look. Nothing else about Strikechamp changes.
Helmeted lower-only: bare chest, red pants, helmet. The REGULAR no-armor look (not a rare variant, not superseded). Visually verified from the locked atlas 2026-10-25.

No-helmet full unsuited: face showing, red suit. A RARE SHINY VARIANT (~10%). NOT the regular no-armor look and NOT a replacement for the lower-only atlas. Visually verified from the locked atlas 2026-10-25.

phase: B (Strikechamp suited default is Region 1 #030, Phase A; the variant-structure correction is Phase B per the 2026-10-25 ~21:55 re-sequence)
png_status: manifest-only correction: all three atlas PNGs were already canonical (visually verified 2026-10-25) and are byte-identical copies of the game-ready locked atlases. Only the manifests + this index changed.
